title: KCP project_access_policy_change_prepare request (DESIGN.md §10.1, §11.6.1 project access-policy change family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Prepares a ProjectAccessPolicyChange over the exact affected Space frontiers/item set and effective audience (§10.1). Args carry only the proposal deltas; Kovee pins the prior values, affected sets, digests, and effective-change class server-side, and the exact project revision travels as meta.expected_revision (gap note KG17). Neither proposed member is individually required — a non-empty delta is an admission rule (gap note KG17). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / authenticated project owner principal only (assurance: current login). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

args.description: Proposal deltas only (§10.1 field names verbatim); prior_*, affected_space_frontier_refs, digests, effective_change, subject_digest, and prepared_by_principal are server-derived (gap notes KG5/KG17).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
